value.0: A breeding pen's broken gate hangs from one hinge, its bars bent outward and gnawed. A tukata's spoor is everywhere.
A scarred feeding post stands in the preserve, its wood ridged with claw marks and old blood. A shyrack roosts somewhere above.
A trampled clearing in the preserve, the ground pounded flat in a steady rhythm. An iriaz bull marks it as his own.
